title: Access control comes before the model
description: If a user can't read a document, the model never sees it. Filtering the answer afterwards is too late.

title: Humans own irreversible decisions
description: The model drafts client emails and ranks candidates. A person reviews the draft and makes the hiring decision.

title: Prefer deterministic over magical
description: LLMs suggest. Regular code validates the output, computes the scores, and decides what gets saved.

title: Pick the simplest design that works
description: Single-step RAG when users don't need chat history. Simulated Annealing when it's easier to reason about than a genetic algorithm.
